drafted_from: tool:github:ocrmypdf-ocrmypdf's row in tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json (job, run, get_it, needs) and its sources row in sources.json; the command is the row's own run line with synthetic names filled in. What it prints or writes is read from the tool's documented behavior; the folder test test/index-github-tools.test.mjs only checks the row, never runs OCRmyPDF.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Use OCRmyPDF on my computer to make a scanned PDF searchable by adding the text it shows: the file is scan.pdf." It reads the row, installs OCRmyPDF if it is missing, runs it on that one file and shows you what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: OCRmyPDF is a program that runs on the person's own computer and works on the one file or address it is handed.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Use OCRmyPDF on scan.pdf". It reads the row with run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:ocrmypdf-ocrmypdf"}.

2. It checks that tesseract, ghostscript are on your computer, and if OCRmyPDF is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/ocrmypdf/OCRmyPDF.git ; brew install ocrmypdf (macOS), or pip install ocrmypdf.
3. It runs the row's command with your file in place of {input} and where the result goes in place of {output}: ocrmypdf scan.pdf scan-searchable.pdf
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. Trillion runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.

worked_examples.title: OCRmyPDF on a 3 page PDF that is only pictures of paper pages
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json: tool:github:ocrmypdf-ocrmypdf runs on your computer, so after tools:list the AI runs, in the folder it got OCRmyPDF in, the command line: ocrmypdf scan.pdf scan-searchable.pdf  (synthetic input: a 3 page PDF that is only pictures of paper pages).
worked_examples.hands_back: ocrmypdf writes scan-searchable.pdf: the same 3 pages looking the same, with the text it read added as an invisible layer so you can search and select words in it.
